name: Kathmandu Valley Rim Mountain Biking
sub_region: Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Kavrepalanchok and Lalitpur districts, Bagmati Province (incl. Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park)

difficulty.notes: Mix of jeep tracks, single track and paved sections with long climbs; some technical, steep descents (e.g. Shivapuri 'Scar Road', 'Widow Maker') and possible bike carrying in wet season. Day rides around Shivapuri/Nagarjun can be easier.

duration_days.basis: riding days Kathmandu to Kathmandu (vehicle support)
duration_days.notes: Day-ride options: Budhanilkantha - Shivapuri helipad; Balaju - Kakani (~23 km); Nagarkot descents; Phulchowki/Godawari; Chandragiri/Chitlang/Pharping in the west. Multi-day rim loop varies 4-6 days by operator.

max_altitude_point: Nagarkot (reported; Shivapuri ridge trails may be higher - Shivapuri peak is 2,732 m but not on standard routes)
end_point: Godawari / Lakuri Bhanjyang, transfer to Kathmandu

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Budhanilkantha (transfer) - ride through Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park - Mulkharka - Chisapani
itinerary.notes: Park entry fee paid at the gate (e-ticketing available).

itinerary.route: Chisapani - Nagarkot along the northern/eastern rim, off-road trails and villages
Namobuddha - Panauti - Lakuri Bhanjyang forest ridge
Lakuri Bhanjyang - ridge single track - Godawari - transfer to Kathmandu
itinerary.notes: Some operators finish via Asapuri Mahadev and the Kailashnath Mahadev (Shiva) statue.

best_seasons.notes: Monsoon makes trails muddy; dry season is dusty. General operator guidance.

permits.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entry
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; SAARC NPR 600; Nepali NPR 100; under 10 free

permits.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park mountain bike fee
permits.fee: NPR 1,000 per mountain bike per entry/day (set 2014; whether still charged separately from the person fee in 2026 is unclear)

guide_requirements: No legal guide requirement for valley-rim riding outside trekking regulations; OutdoorKing would use a professional MTB guide with mechanical skills and vehicle support.

drives: Support jeep for luggage and shuttles
logistics.notes: Hill-station lodges/resorts at Chisapani, Nagarkot, Namobuddha and Lakuri Bhanjyang. Bikes can be rented in Thamel.

highlights: Single track through the forests of Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park, just north of Kathmandu
Himalayan panoramas from Chisapani, Nagarkot and Lakuri Bhanjyang
Newar towns of Dhulikhel and Panauti and Tamang villages
Nagarkot's trails have hosted Asian enduro events
risks: Shared trails/roads with jeeps and heavy vehicles
Mud and landslide-damaged trails after monsoon
Dust and air quality near the city

acclimatization.notes: Riding stays below ~2,200 m; no acclimatization needed.

secondary_keywords: Kathmandu Valley rim mountain bike tour

unverified: Multi-day rim itinerary and overnight stops are from two operators (Satori Adventures, High Pass Adventure) whose routes differ (Kakani start vs Budhanilkantha start).
Overnight altitudes Chisapani 2,140 m and Nagarkot 2,195 m are from one operator; others list Nagarkot ~2,175 m.
Mountain bike fee of NPR 1,000 at Shivapuri dates from a 2014 report; a 2026 trail site lists 'Foreigner NPR 1000 + 65' without clarifying whether that is per rider or per bike.
Asian enduro events at Nagarkot from a single local site.
